uutiset.t: Australia Bonds Set for Longest Rally Since June on RBA Cut Bets
uutiset.s: Australia’s bond market is heading for its longest rally in over five months as mounting signs of economic weakness fuel bets the Reserve Bank’s next move will be an interest-rate cut.

uutiset.t: GQG Shares Set for Record Surge in Sydney With AI Trade Revival
uutiset.s: GQG Partners Inc.’s Australia-listed shares are on track for a record daily gain, as a rebound in the artificial intelligence trade drew investors back into Rajiv Jain’s beaten-down investment firm.

uutiset.t: Shares in Chinese Cobalt Producers Jump After Congo Bans Exports
uutiset.s: Shares in Chinese cobalt producers surged after the Democratic Republic of Congo slapped an export ban on the battery metal from the end of the month in a bid to arrest a price decline.

uutiset.t: Japanese Bonds Rally Across Curve as Domestic Stocks Surge
uutiset.s: Japanese government bonds rallied across the curve after a three-day holiday, with gains holding even as domestic equities surged on easing concerns over the outlook for artificial intelligence investment.

uutiset.t: Copper Resumes Decline as Investors Look Beyond Drama at Nvidia
uutiset.s: Copper resumed a decline after a spike driven by Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia Corp., with investors still cautious about demand.

uutiset.t: Copper Smelters Face Worsening Squeeze as Negotiations Stall
uutiset.s: Copper smelters are bracing for a period of extreme financial pressure as closely-watched negotiations over supply contracts for next year go down to the wire.

uutiset.t: Malaysia Index Rejig Puts Tech, Power Stocks in Focus for 2027
uutiset.s: Malaysia is gearing up for the first major overhaul of its equity benchmark in 17 years, a shake-up that may channel more investor money into technology and energy companies just as traders rethink the profitability of the AI trade.

uutiset.t: Keppel Agrees to Merge Telecom Firms M1 and Starhub
uutiset.s: Asset manager Keppel Ltd. agreed to combine M1 Ltd. with Starhub Ltd. in an all-share deal, bringing together two of Singapore’s major telecommunications operators following months of talks.

uutiset.t: US Senate Probes Vance Role in Vitol Choice for Venezuela Oil
uutiset.s: A US senator is investigating the role Vice President JD Vance played in awarding a lucrative Venezuelan oil contract to a political donor and then-executive at commodities trader Vitol Group.

uutiset.t: Petrobras Makes $470 Million Ethanol Bet in Brazil With Neomille Stake
uutiset.s: Brazil’s state-controlled oil producer Petrobras is buying a stake in corn-ethanol producer Neomille SA as part of a wider expansion into biofuels.

uutiset.t: Gold Extends Gain After Nvidia’s Rehiring of Huang Sparks Rally
uutiset.s: Gold rose for a second day, after Jensen Huang’s surprise return to the helm of Nvidia Corp. recharged bets on artificial intelligence and spurred rallies across markets.

uutiset.t: AI Trade Rebound Drives Limit Up Moves in Nvidia Supplier Stocks
uutiset.s: Asian semiconductor-related stocks climbed after Nvidia Corp.’s board reinstated Jensen Huang, resuscitating investor appetite for the artificial intelligence trade.

uutiset.t: Why Did Nvidia Reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO?
uutiset.s: A White House pressure campaign and a $5 trillion market slide forced Nvidia to reinstate its founder — proving that in the AI race, boardroom discipline is a luxury shareholders can’t afford.

uutiset.t: Startup Options Exchange Asks SEC to Approve Two New Venues
uutiset.s: Options Xchange Group Inc., a startup bourse focused on equity derivatives, is seeking to start two new venues.

uutiset.t: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 24
uutiset.s: Oil pushed lower after sliding more than 3% in the previous session on cautious optimism over efforts to end the US-Iran war.
